content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-128","Title":"getTr rejects legacy TR IDs that listTr returns","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["workflow.requirements.listTr returns all persisted TR rows, including legacy IDs such as TR-066/TR-067. workflow.requirements.getTr (and updateTr/deleteTr) call ValidateTrId before lookup using TrIdPattern ^TR-[A-Z0-9]\u002B(?:-[A-Z0-9]\u002B)\u002B-\\d{3}$, which rejects short legacy forms like TR-066 before any store access. REST GetTrById looks up by equality without that pre-check. Result: plugin agents cannot get/update/delete listed legacy TRs, so retiring them via the authoritative workflow path is blocked unless a migration or relaxed read/mutate path is added.","Triage group: triage-group-1e18f42eee0ae8a7","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- Given a workspace whose store already contains TR-066 (or another non-canonical TR id returned by listTr), workflow.requirements.getTr with that id returns the persisted entry instead of failing ID-format validation.","- workflow.requirements.updateTr and deleteTr succeed against the same persisted legacy id so obsolete entries can be retired or corrected through the workflow surface.","- workflow.requirements.createTr continues to reject newly created non-canonical TR ids (or documents and enforces an explicit migration/rewrite path if create is intentionally relaxed).","- listTr and getTr remain consistent: every id returned by listTr is retrievable by getTr without a pre-lookup format rejection.","Implementation notes:","- Primary gate is McpServer.Repl.Core.RequirementsWorkflow: ListTrAsync does not validate ids; GetTrAsync/UpdateTrAsync/DeleteTrAsync call ValidateTrId with TrIdPattern ^TR-[A-Z0-9]\u002B(?:-[A-Z0-9]\u002B)\u002B-\\d{3}$ and throw ArgumentException (Expected format: TR-\u003CAREA\u003E-\u003CSUBAREA\u003E[-\u003CQUALIFIER\u003E]-###).","- Preferred fix: apply strict canonical validation only on create (and optionally batch create); for get/update/delete, accept non-empty ids and resolve against the store (404 if missing). Optionally accept a documented legacy pattern (e.g. TR-\\d\u002B) for mutate paths only.","- Alternative: provide a one-shot migration/repair that rewrites or deletes non-canonical persisted TR/FR/TEST ids, then keep strict validation everywhere; until that exists, read/mutate must still reach persisted rows.","- Server REST RequirementsController GetTrByIdAsync already looks up without format validation; align workflow/plugin semantics with that, or document a supported migration path if the plugin path remains strict."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
